mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as investors price in sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative (positive return rate < 40%).

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation, triggering market expectations of monetary tightening and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when CPIAUCSL_yoy > 2.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive (negative return rate < 40%).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL_yoy > 2.5%) indicates policy misalignment, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns due to stagflation fears and reduced market risk tolerance.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5 AND CPIAUCSL_yoy > 2.5, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1_yoy_growth > 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns through elevated corporate earnings expectations and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when GDPC1_yoy_growth > 2.0%, the 60-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market, supporting consumer spending and positive 5-day S&P 500 returns as equity markets anticipate sustained earnings momentum.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, the 5-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) signals weakening economic activity, triggering negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as market participants price in recession risks and reduced corporate demand.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when INDPRO < 100, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts (HOUST < 1300) and weak real sales (RSAFS < 500000) indicate deteriorating consumer demand, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns through reduced consumption-driven earnings growth.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when HOUST < 1300 AND RSAFS < 500000, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals active monetary tightening, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns as liquidity constraints and higher borrowing costs depress equity valuations.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods when FEDFUNDS_3m_rise > 0.5, the 20-day forward returns are positive.
